events.description: As polar ice melts in the Arctic, shipping lanes are opening up, making the region a new zone of superpower competition. Writer Rana Foroohar explains the stakes in Sea Change.

events.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
events.description: Factory workers in India are being asked to wear GoPro cameras to record the way they do their jobs. The ultimate goal is to train robots to take over. Will it work?

events.ticker_label: 🪖 Hypersonic missiles highlight arms race on Korean Peninsula

events.title: Germany news: Train station alcohol ban comes into force
events.description: Consuming alcohol is no longer permitted at train stations in Germany, to improve the lot of travelers and staff alike. Coalition talks are restarting in Berlin, and an inmate is loose in Essen. Follow DW for more.

events.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
events.description: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.

events.title: Brazil to shorten workweek in win for Lula ahead of runoff
events.description: Brazil's Senate approved cutting the workweek from 44 to 40 hours. The move could give President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva an edge over his opponent, Flavio Bolsonaro, ahead of the October 25 runoff.

events.title: China, North Korea open long-delayed trade bridge
events.description: China and North Korea formally opened the Yalu River Bridge on Thursday, connecting Dandong in China with Sinuiju in North Korea. Beijing says the bridge will promote economic and trade cooperation.

events.title: Russia detains independent outlet Novaya Gazeta editor Sergei Sokolov
events.description: Sergei Sokolov, the editor-in-chief of Russia's independent newspaper Novaya Gazeta, was detained and taken for questioning on Thursday after authorities searched his home, the newspaper said.

events.title: A cultural stroll through Paris with photographer Nikos Aliagas and writer Jean-Paul Enthoven
events.description: This week in Paris des Arts, Valérie Fayolle hosts Nikos Aliagas, a TV presenter and photographer. He takes us to his exhibit on old age at the Musée de l’Homme.

events.title: Pope thanks well-wishers for prayers after cancer operation

events.title: Pope Leo undergoes blood tests, X-ray following cancer surgery, Vatican says
events.description: Pope Leo XIV began walking and resumed eating after thoracic surgery at Rome's Gemelli Hospital, with blood tests and an X-ray being part of his recovery.

events.title: Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons remove part of right lung, Vatican says
